scenes.voice: Trabaho Biñan. Jobs in Biñan, all in one place.

scenes.headline: Free. No account needed.
scenes.voice: Looking for work? Browse current vacancies from local employers, for free, with no account needed.

scenes.headline: Search by job or company
scenes.voice: Search by job title or company.

scenes.headline: Filter to what fits you
scenes.voice: Then filter by job type, location, and the education you have.

scenes.headline: Pay, place and deadline, up front
scenes.voice: Every listing shows where you'll work, the pay, the closing date, and exactly how to apply.

scenes.headline: Apply here with your résumé
scenes.voice: Some jobs let you apply right here. Add your details, upload your résumé, and get a reference number.

scenes.headline: Never pay to apply
scenes.voice: And remember: never pay to apply. If a listing asks for fees, report it.
Find your next job on Trabaho Biñan.
scenes.subtitle: Find your next job at trabaho.bantaybinan.com

backoffice.title: Behind the listings
backoffice.tagline: For employers, PESO reviewers and administrators.
backoffice.musicCredit: “Inspired” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

scenes.voice: Behind every listing on Trabaho Biñan are simple tools for employers, PESO reviewers, and administrators.

scenes.headline: Your own employer dashboard
scenes.voice: Invited employers post vacancies from their own dashboard.

scenes.headline: Role, pay and how to apply
scenes.voice: They fill in the role, the pay, and how to apply, including whether to accept résumés right on the site.

scenes.headline: Submitted for review
scenes.voice: Then submit it. Nothing goes public until PESO checks it.

scenes.headline: Everything that needs attention
scenes.voice: Reviewers see what needs attention at a glance, starting with the review queue.

scenes.headline: Check, then publish
scenes.voice: They check the details, with wording like age or gender limits flagged automatically, then publish in one click.

scenes.headline: A private applications inbox
scenes.voice: Applications arrive in the employer's inbox. Résumés stay private, every download is recorded, and each applicant's status is tracked.

scenes.headline: Every change on record
scenes.voice: Administrators can trace every change in the audit history,

scenes.headline: Access and settings
scenes.voice: and manage staff access and site settings.
Trabaho Biñan. Accurate listings and safe applications, for the people of Biñan.
scenes.subtitle: Trabaho Biñan: accurate listings and safe applications, for the people of Biñan.
